dedupe_keys.name: finnish transport infrastructure agency vaylavirasto open data and suomen vaylat map service

description: The Finnish Transport Infrastructure Agency opens its data on the road, railway and waterway networks of Finland for free public use, as required by the Finnish Act on Transport Services. The Suomen Väylät map service is the central place to view and download the open data, with thematic maps such as road repair debt and road traffic volumes, and the same data are offered through WMS and WFS open APIs, which replaced the older services in 2023. A description of the content of the open railway network data was published in 2023, and the agency provides a QGIS plug-in for searching road and street addresses. Coverage is Finland. Access: free file downloads and self-service APIs under open licence terms; the specific licence is given on the agency's other pages, not the overview read. Caveats: much documentation is in Finnish, and the overview does not list every dataset. It supports road, rail and waterway network topology, asset condition and repair backlog analysis, hazard exposure of transport networks and network flow modelling, and complements Fintraffic's Digitraffic real-time data catalogued here.
